T3.texte: every open tab is a tiny [[unfinished task]] tugging at you. keep the one you need, save the rest for later

en: NO social media for the first

en: no tiktok for the first hour

T2.texte: not face down on the desk, not in your pocket, out of sight

T3.texte: even on silent, a phone in sight keeps a corner of your brain on standby. the start of a task is when you drift off the fastest, so [[protect those minutes]]

T4.texte: the group chat [[will be just fine]]

T1.texte: write the thought down, [[don't follow it]]

en: YOU! most people swipe through slideshows like
this and never read the actual text
T2.fr: TOI ! la plupart des gens font défiler ce genre de slides et [[lisent jamais le vrai texte]]
T2.texte: mid-task your brain suddenly needs to answer that text or look up that one actor

T3.texte: keep a scrap of paper nearby, write it down and [[go right back]]

en: if you’re still reading this, your
attention span is better than most

T3.texte: a lesson has an end. you reach it, close it, and [[actually remember it]]

T4.fr: au lieu de mon [[doomscroll]] habituel, mes 5 min du jour sur [[l'appli Sophia]] : pourquoi Camus imagine Sisyphe heureux

T3.texte: the email, then the dishes, then the next thing. [[one at a time]], all the way

en: people who seem comfortable with silence often
come across as more confident because they aren’t
T4.fr: les gens à l'aise avec le silence ont souvent l'air [[plus sûrs d'eux]], parce qu'ils cherchent pas à tout prix à plaire
T4.texte: it feels slower at first, it really isn't. and at night your head is finally quiet, because [[nothing is left open]]
